question: Should OpenClaw canonize `capabilities/*.md` as a core workspace documentation convention, or keep capability discovery guidance limited to existing workspace skills, plugins, `TOOLS.md`, and explicit bootstrap mechanisms?
rationale: The change is not a bug fix: it establishes a new user-facing documentation surface whose relationship to the fixed bootstrap contract and existing capability surfaces requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Keep existing capability surfaces
options.body: Do not add the new inventory convention; clarify discovery through workspace skills, plugins, `TOOLS.md`, and supported explicit bootstrap mechanisms instead.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow inventory convention
options.body: Accept the docs contract only if maintainers want a non-runtime index and explicitly define its scope, discoverability limits, and relationship to `TOOLS.md` and skills.

recommendation.title: Keep existing capability surfaces
recommendation.body: Do not add the new inventory convention; clarify discovery through workspace skills, plugins, `TOOLS.md`, and supported explicit bootstrap mechanisms instead.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the documentation/product owner most closely connected to the existing workspace and capability guidance.
